Accounts Officer Job at Sales Force Consulting




        
    

        
        Sales Force Consulting - Our client, a Production Company for cellotape adhesive tapes, gums and diverse stationery items is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Accounts Officer
Job Location: Agbara, Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description:
     

            
    




	General book-keeping ensuring that all financial transactions are captured through the company’s accounting software
	Carryout periodic and prompt reconciliations with bankers, debtors and creditors by monitoring account statements regularly to ensure they tally with the company’s records.
	Enforce basic HR practices and ensure proper management of staff resources


Qualification / Requirements:


	Possess an HND / B.Sc in Accounting with at least 4 years post-NYSC Accounts work experience.
	Knwoledge of HR is an advantage
	Residing within Agbara axis is required


Other Requirements:


	Applicants must be very hardworking with high level of integrity
	Candidate must presently reside within Agbara axis


Skill Set:


	Accounting
	Ability to work independently with little supervision.
	Attention to details
	Leadership skills
	Organizational skills
	Basic HR


Salary
N180,000 - N230,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV (PDF or Word) to: [email protected] using "Accounts Officer" as the subject of the email.

Note:


	For enquiries, send a message to: 08120796570 (WhatsApp)
	Only candidates who meet set criteria shall be shortlisted for interview
	Interview mode: Physical
